purpose: Exact-commit GitHub Actions result collection after native/managed performance candidates were withdrawn.
outcome: FAIL; no global CI pass is claimed.
no_local_execution: No local tests, builds, workflow edits, reruns or gate changes were performed for this collection.
attribution_limits: Every failed GPU test remains a failure, not skipped or passed.

Linux/Windows direct GPU tests expose the absent hardware Vulkan adapter diagnostic; Apple exposes its disabled Vulkan target. These are observed initialization failures, not evidence that the GPU algorithms pass on supported hardware.

The native pathfinder FFI failure only reports -1 versus expected 0. It is consistent with initialization failure, but this test log does not expose the backend reason; no stronger attribution is claimed.
Nine ignored native cases are explicitly manual timing harnesses. Their ignored status does not suppress the eleven failed GPU tests.
Native platform build, loader smoke, artifact upload and final bundle did not execute after suite failure; no CI-produced multi-platform bundle is certified.
The 87 whitespace failure and cancelled reference job remain visible. Separate 005 quality/reference results do not overwrite their historical conclusions.
Jobs were collected from the exact push SHA and run attempt 1; no PR-only helper or latest-main inference was used.
evidence_log_format: Downloaded decoded job logs are stored as UTF-8 with CRLF normalized to LF; content is otherwise retained.
successor_difference: GitHub compare returns one changed file, tests/CycleTrim.Optimizations.Tests/PropertyTextureFixture.cs, deleting one blank EOF line; no native files differ.
